title: Tenant-scoped cache
spec: Implement lookup(cache, tenant, record_id, load). Cache results separately for each (tenant, record_id). Call load(tenant, record_id) only on a miss. The cache is a mutable dictionary initially empty; both identifiers are strings. Return the cached or loaded value.
target_defect: The cache key omits tenant, so equal record identifiers collide across tenants.
author_rationale: The change keeps a single cache lookup path and avoids repeated loads.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
